# Skein

> Skein is a tiny zero-dependency, HTML-first Web Components runtime with fine-grained reactivity for creative CSS, SVG, Canvas and native-DOM sites.

Current runtime: Skein 0.5. Production entry: `skein.min.js` — 14.0 kB raw, 5.1 kB gzip, 4.6 kB Brotli. No virtual DOM, npm dependency or required build step.

Important code-generation rules: keep static/semantic/SEO-critical content in ordinary HTML; use Skein for interactive regions. Bindings inside `{...}` are property paths. Use `computed()` for derived state, stable `key={id}` for application lists, `@event={handler}` for events, and `onCleanup()` / `abortSignal` for owned resources.

Public API: `Skein.version` and `Skein.define(tag, source)`. Component-script helpers: `computed`, `effect`, `onCleanup`, `host`, `abortSignal`. Do not use removed v0.4-era low-level APIs such as `batch`, `signal`, `untrack`, `Skein.stats` or `Skein.flush`.

## Start

- [60-second start](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/start/): one-file `<template skein>` app with no npm or build step.
- [README](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/blob/main/README.md): framework overview, API, rendering model, lifecycle, build and tests.
